lines.say: Tier F, doing nothing. Almost half of Squire's clients book once, then vanish.
Tier D, paying for new clients. Book-see Boost takes thirty percent of that first visit.
Tier C, asking at the chair. It misses everyone who already left.
Tier B, texting them yourself. It works, until you have hundreds of clients and forget somebody.
Also tier B, Vah-rah-go. A booking tool first, and text marketing costs extra.
Tier A, Book-see. A great booking app, but its big push is bringing in new clients.
Gloss Genius. Built to run the whole business, so retention is one feature of many.
Squire runs the whole shop well. Retention is just one tool in the box.
Tier S, Message Health. It scores every client, and catches who's drifting.
Then it texts them for you. Built for Atlanta barbers, with a real person to call.
If you wanna see why we are better, comment RETAIN, and I will DM you. Not an automated one.
